sections.title: REPRESENTATION
sections.fact: Hamilton is the first and, to date, only Black driver to compete in Formula 1 in the championship's history, which began in 1950.
sections.editorial: The statistic is unusual among sporting records in that it describes an absence as much as an achievement. It is the single fact most often cited when his career is placed in a context wider than results.

sections.title: THE HAMILTON COMMISSION
sections.fact: In 2020 Hamilton established the Hamilton Commission with the Royal Academy of Engineering to research the under-representation of Black people in UK motorsport. Its report, Accelerating Change, was published in July 2021 with recommendations covering schools, apprenticeships and team recruitment.
sections.editorial: It is a research programme rather than a campaign, and it is unusual for an active driver to commission independent academic work about the industry employing him.

sections.title: MISSION 44
sections.fact: Hamilton launched Mission 44 in 2021, a charitable foundation supporting young people from under-represented groups in education, employment and motorsport.
sections.editorial: The number appears again. By this point 44 had stopped being a racing number and started being an identifier attached to everything else.

sections.title: ACTIVISM
sections.fact: Across the 2020 season Hamilton wore anti-racism messaging on the grid and publicly pressed Formula 1 and the FIA on the sport's response. Formula 1 subsequently launched its We Race As One initiative.
sections.editorial: Whether a driver should use a race weekend as a platform remains contested. What is not contested is that the position cost him nothing competitively and was taken while he was winning the championship.

sections.title: FASHION AND CULTURE
sections.fact: Hamilton has appeared on the cover of Vogue, co-chaired the 2021 Met Gala, and holds long-running commercial relationships in fashion and music.
sections.editorial: The paddock's relationship with celebrity changed during his career. He is not the only cause of that, but he is the clearest example of it.

sections.title: YOUTH AND ACCESS
sections.fact: Karting, the entry point to single-seater racing, carries costs that the Hamilton Commission's report identified as a structural barrier. Hamilton's own junior career was funded through the McLaren young driver programme he joined at thirteen.
sections.editorial: His route into the sport is frequently described as unlikely. The more precise description is that it depended on a support programme that most drivers never access.

sections.title: ADVOCACY
sections.fact: Hamilton has been publicly vegan since 2017 and has spoken about environmental and animal welfare positions in interviews and on social media.
sections.editorial: These positions sit outside motorsport and are included here as fact rather than as part of the sporting record.
